name: dlssg-plain
description: reporter 1's box: UE4SS 1.79 and the mod, nothing else in the DXGI or D3D12 slot, with the game's own Streamline / DLSS-G loaded and frame generation off in the menu

report.who: reporter 1 (Nexus, 2026-09-07, four sessions of logs), and probably lxk4991588 + wuhuqifei66, who sent a sentence each
report.verdict: HIS: Present returns DEVICE_REMOVED, then Unreal's 120 s RenderThread timeout. NOT REPRODUCED HERE — fourteen instrumented runs, two machines, three game installs. See notes.md; this profile asserts the install and promises HEALTHY, never his crash

payloads.note: he had no ReShade; this box's proxy comes off. Windows' own dxgi.dll still loads from System32, which is why expect matches on the END of a module's path
this box's DLSSNR runtime, installed beside RenoDX. NOT the game's own DLSS-G, which lives under Engine\Plugins\Runtime\Nvidia\ and is exactly what this profile keeps

game_config_expect.note: read out of GameConfig.sav, never written into it - the same blob carries the owner's playtime, equipment and achievements. His configuration was DLSS on with frame generation OFF in the menu, and nvngx_dlssg.dll loads either way, so the menu is the only place this fact exists.

expect.note: the configuration, not his crash. Streamline and DLSS-G ship with the game and load on every launch - that is the 'DLSS-G loaded' half of his box - while every injector this install carries must be gone from the process.

manual.ue4ss: he ran `HookInitGameState = 0`, as the mod's own install instructions say. UE4SS's settings are not managed by this script; if that line is ever changed on this box, this profile stops describing his machine.
manual.unreachable: four things about his box this one cannot be: the Steam overlay always injects GameOverlayRenderer64.dll here so Present is never his `no detour`; no reachable setting produces his 2-back-buffer swapchain; 2560x1440 and HDR need hardware this box has not. See notes.md.
manual.driver_vsync: the owner's word — not readable from a script
manual.monitors: three: 1920x1080 @ 75 Hz primary, 1920x1080 @ 100 Hz, 1080x1920 @ 75 Hz rotated; the game runs on the primary
